page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, which consists of 94,489 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the massive local HDD capacity and dedicated CPU resources, this instance offers high resource density for storage-bound workloads. It is qualitatively cost-effective for scenarios requiring large-scale sequential data access rather than high-IOPS random access. Appropriate workloads include distributed file systems, big data analytics, data warehousing, and large-scale log processing.
